source.name: CerebrA: Mindboggle-101 DKT labels registered and hand-corrected on MNI-ICBM152 2009c Symmetric
source.citation: Manera AL, Dadar M, Fonov V, Collins DL. CerebrA, registration and manual label correction of Mindboggle-101 atlas for MNI-ICBM152 template. Sci Data 2020;7:237. doi:10.1038/s41597-020-0557-9 (dataset G-Node doi:10.12751/g-node.be5e62, released under CC0 1.0 Public Domain Dedication; files taken from the TemplateFlow mirror tpl-MNI152NLin2009cSym, whose template carries the MNI/McGill licence).

modifications: Distributed GLB files are unmodified originals or upstream LOD meshes. At runtime, selected triangles are cropped for illustrative regional overlays while the anatomical body stays intact. These authored spatial crops are not validated functional-network masks. Colours and stage-specific light paths are illustrative, not measured activity or anatomical tracts.

Apache-2.0.name: Apache License 2.0 (the MASSP project's own licence; the distributor of the file states none)
Apache-2.0.attribution: MASSP subcortical parcellation, (c) Pierre-Louis Bazin, University of Amsterdam. The file used here is TemplateFlow's tpl-MNI152NLin2009cAsym_res-01_atlas-MASSP20_dseg.nii.gz, which arrives with no licence and no copyright notice of its own -- TemplateFlow publishes no sidecar for it. Apache License 2.0 is the licence the MASSP authors placed on the atlas priors the parcellation is produced from (doi:10.21942/uva.12074175), and it is recorded here as the best-evidenced upstream terms rather than as a statement by the distributor. The meshes derived from it are modified: the parcellation was read on the MNI152NLin2009cAsym grid, meshed by signed-distance field, smoothed, decimated and welded as the manifest records per mesh.
